$comment: Starter recipe for v0.1.4 — produces crosswalk-edge notes between NIST CSF subcategories and NIST 800-53 controls. Schema-conformant against spec/recipe.schema.json. STRM predicate vocabulary enforced by Tier 1 schema validation at write time. SSSOM-shaped envelope (match_type, match_confidence, mapping_justification, mapping_provider). user_preserve guards review_status + creator_id + free-form notes against being overwritten on re-import. Intended consumption: produces notes that downstream Bases queries can join CSF-side and 800-53-side concept notes.
